mapper.insert: insert into board(title, writer, content) values(#{title},#{writer},#{content});
mapper.select: select board_id,title,writer,content,regdate,hit from board order by board_id desc;
select board_id,title,writer,content,regdate,hit from board where board_id = #{board_id};
mapper.update: update board set title =#{title}, writer =#{writer}, content=#{content} where board_id = #{board_id};
